description: Finalize a commit: style.md vs git log first if needed, then draft GitKraken Summary and Description, then offer git commit first, then copy / edit / rewrite / stop. Wording is shown before those choices. Use when they want to change the message or actually create the commit, or /crav1-finalize-commit. Does not push. Does not commit until they pick commit. Paste-only: /crav1-draft-commit-message. Keeps a trailing work-item mention through the HEAD check and the Cursor attribution strip.
